verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents invoice payment automation, vendor bill pay, smart invoice scanning, and an MCP tool that can 'pay vendors and handle bills — review bill pay invoices, manage vendors,' which covers vendor payment routing. However, there is no evidence of purchase-order matching (3-way match) or GL/expense coding of invoices, which are core parts of this story. Missing for 10: purchase order matching/reconciliation, invoice coding to GL accounts, and end-to-end approval routing workflow evidence beyond generic 'approval flows' mention.
